audit.whatIsWrong: Page rates the lane EVEN with the full-layer level chart reading 'Skill' for Levels 1-6 while the content layer reads 'Ahri' for the same rows.
audit.why: 47.17% win rate over 1414 games plus Ahri's 970-range Orb of Deception against Azir's 525 soldier range means she owns every early row. The two layers rendered different answers to 'who wins Level 1'.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side set to Ahri to match win[0..4], with each why rewritten to explain the Ahri verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose did not key to real cooldowns; level 6 row claimed Azir wins every 2v2 with R.
audit.why: Spirit Rush is 140/120/100 with three casts and recasts on takedown; Emperor's Divide is 120/105/90 and a single wall. Her 6 is the bigger spike; Azir's is Nashor's + 2 items.
audit.corrected: Level 6 row now states Spirit Rush's three dashes vs one wall and tells you to hold R for her commit; carry/late fields keyed to the 100s R.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Charm 'instantly stops movement abilities', which cancels Shifting Sands mid-dash. Nothing mentioned Orb of Deception's return hit being true damage.
audit.why: Riot's Charm text explicitly stops movement abilities, so Azir's E is not an escape once Charm is in the air. Orb returns as true damage, so MR is the wrong purchase.
audit.corrected: Stated in tldr, winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[0] and phases[2].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all.
audit.why: It is the field that holds real cooldowns; lint flagged COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT.
audit.corrected: Charm 12s flat, Azir E 19s at rank 3, Spirit Rush 100s at rank 3, Orb 7s flat.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text claimed she can 'Charm you through minions'.
audit.why: Charm damages and charms 'an enemy it encounters' — it stops on the first unit hit, so a minion body eats it.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to say Charm stops on the first thing it touches and she must angle around the wave.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet flagged whys[4] 'Her Spirit Rush' as a probable wrong ability name.
audit.why: Spirit Rush is Ahri's real R name in the kit file. False positive.

notes: CHART: phases[0..4].side read 'Skill' while content win[0..4] already read 'Ahri' — a cross-layer disagreement on five rows. I moved the full-layer side to Ahri to match the content layer and the packet levelChart, and rewrote every matching why in the same proposal. No paired win[N] edit is included for these rows because win[0..4] already say 'Ahri' on disk; a no-op edit would be rejected. This proposal REMOVES a disagreement rather than introducing one. Anti-heal: Essence Theft heals her off minion waves and off takedowns — Grievous Wounds timing matters in extended trades, but I could not source an Azir-appropriate anti-heal item timing from the kits and did not invent one. Packet suspectName 'Her Spirit Rush' in whys[4] is a FALSE POSITIVE — Spirit Rush is the real R name; left alone.
